content.title: Against Celsus
content.author: Origen · Ante-Nicene Fathers vol. 4 (1885), tr. Frederick Crombie
content.note: Origen's reply to the pagan critic Celsus, which preserves much of Celsus's own attack. For the earliest full critique of Christianity and a reply to it; Origen's own speculations are not taught here.
